title: ClearPath Late Fees and the Restart Re-Pricing of Professional Services Projects
content:
Late fees on a client's ClearPath Managed IT Services billing add points to the restart re-pricing of a held Professional Services Projects engagement.

**Rule.** For a client whose ClearPath billing shows two or more late fees posted in the twelve months before the re-pricing date, 1.0 point is added to the restart re-pricing, 0.5 point for exactly one, and none otherwise.

**Window.** The re-pricing date is the day the client signs the restart change order. A late fee counts when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the re-pricing date, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| ClearPath late fees posted in the twelve months | Points added |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.0 |
| exactly one | 0.5 |
| none, or no ClearPath billing | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a client with three ClearPath late fees, two of them posted more than twelve whole months before the re-pricing date, has one late fee in the window and carries 0.5 point.
